notes:
Summary: Tempo Support Labs is building a ticket-deflection RAG layer for their Zendesk instance and an internal support agent. Priority is high: reduce agent load and SLA breaches by surfacing exact, short answers from historical tickets.

Key constraints / asks (shorthand):
- Index scale: target 8-12M tickets + attachments (text only for POC). Concern about vector store size and reindex cadence.
- Latency SLO: P95 end-to-end < 50ms for embedding+rerank pipeline for top-5, ideally < 100ms for full retrieval+rerank at 8M index. Tight.
- Throughput: avg 120 qps during business hours, burst to 400 qps.
- Cost sensitivity: want cost/query <$0.02 at production scale; POC tolerates higher.
- Quality: reranker must lift top-5 relevance to >85% judged by their QA set; reranker model should be lightweight but high-precision.
- Model preferences: open models preferred (quantized MPT/LLaMA variants) with automatic fallback to smaller Llama2-13B like variants. Want Redwood routing for cost/latency.
- Integration: Zendesk + internal ticket UI; needs SCIM + SSO; webhook-based feedback loop for CTR/deflection metrics.
- Security: SOC2 required, KMS for keys, audit logs retained 1yr, data residency preference for NA. Legal asking about PII redaction in embeddings.

Quotes / paraphrases from calls:
- "We need answers in <100ms or our agents won't adopt it." — Head of Support
- "If the reranker can't get top-5 right, deflection rate drops to zero; that's make-or-break." — ML Lead

POC plan (agreed):
1) Ingest 8M ticket bodies + 2M short attachments (txt) into vector index.
2) Baseline: ANN retrieval + sparse filters -> evaluate latency and recall.
3) Add lightweight cross-encoder reranker (quantized) as top-5 re-ranker; measure top-5 MRR and judge quality.
4) Run load tests (120 qps steady, 400 qps bursts) on Dedicated nodes; capture P95/P99 latencies.
5) Cost modeling: token + GPU runtime per query estimate; target <$0.02/query.

Open questions for Redwood team:
- Exact POC infra footprint (GPU types, dedicated pool sizing) and expected cost numbers for 12M index at target qps
- Reranker model recommendations (size vs latency trade-offs) + any Redwood Optimize profiles for embedding dimensionality/quantization
- How prefix/KV caching would apply for support queries (many repeated templates)

Attachments / refs: pricing deck (drive link), security matrix, sample eval set (private link), Fireflies(call) ids for transcripts.

AE notes: keep POC narrow (text-only), show routing fallback to smaller model for cheaper cold queries, emphasize latency-focused benchmark runs.
use_case_summary: Primary workload: customer support RAG for ticket deflection + assistant. Pipeline: embed query -> ANN retrieval from 8-12M doc index -> lightweight reranker to reorder top-100 -> cross-encoder rerank to top-5 -> response generation optional. KPIs: deflection rate (target 30%), top-5 relevance >85% (human eval), P95 latency <50ms for retrieval+rerank path, cost/query <$0.02. Integration: Zendesk + SCIM/SSO + feedback webhooks.
